name: System Design
blurb: Short videos only: every pick is 20 minutes or less and covers one or two ideas, ordered as a sequence. Most come from ByteByteGo and Gaurav Sen.
method:
• Length: hard cap of 20 minutes per video; depth comes from a sequence.
  • Order: picks in a subtopic are in watching order; the first is the starting point.
  • Sources: ByteByteGo (Alex Xu), Gaurav Sen, Hello Interview and Jordan has no life for deeper interview-style takes. Long full-interview walkthroughs are left out; the short case studies plus practising on paper cover the same ground.
